<p>The galaxy's deadliest warrior has an unquenchable thirst for battle that only death can cure, but no one’s been able to kill Battle Beast yet. And it’s certainly not for a lack of trying. Will Battle Beast rip the titans from Fantania to shreds? Or will visitors from a faraway empire be the ones to end Battle Beast once and for all? Collects Invincible Universe: Battle Beast #7–12.</p>
